task.name: lift_lid_and_put_green_duck
task.description: Use the right arm to lift the lid off the pot, then use the left arm to place the green duck into the pot.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the lid of the pot.
2. Grasp the lid with the right arm.
3. Lift the lid off the pot using the right arm.
4. Move the left arm to approach and align with the green duck.
5. Grasp the green duck with the left arm.
6. Move the left arm to align with the pot.
7. Release the gripper to place the green duck into the pot.
